title: Coordinate decomposition of polynomial evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ be a real multilinear polynomial on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $X_j:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be a family of real-valued functions on a type of inputs $\Omega$. For every $\omega\in\Omega$, the evaluation of $F$ at $X(\omega)$ is the sum of its part omitting coordinate $i$ and $X_i(\omega)$ times the evaluation of the coefficient polynomial of the cube derivative in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a multilinear polynomial on $n$ coordinates
$i$ is an index in the $n$-coordinate set
$X$ is a family of real-valued functions indexed by the $n$ coordinates
replaced: Let $F(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}a_S\prod_{j\in S}x_j$ be a real multilinear polynomial and fix $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Define $A_i(x)=\sum_{S:i\notin S}a_S\prod_{j\in S}x_j$ and $D_i(x)=\sum_{S:i\notin S}a_{S\cup\{i\}}\prod_{j\in S}x_j$. For any functions $X_j\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$ and $\omega\in\Omega$, $F(X(\omega))=A_i(X(\omega))+X_i(\omega)D_i(X(\omega))$.
